content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: rate-limiter-frontend (service: ratecap-svc) — elevated 429 error rate for public endpoints. Trigger: 5xx/429 anomaly threshold exceeded.

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident PDR-94621 created and notified oncall.

maria.b: acked — I'm on it. pinging @ryan.s and @leo for infra context.

ryan.s: thanks — grabbing logs. what tenants are hitting 429s? any pattern?

leo: seeing a spike for multi-tenant customers in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. small steady increase starting ~09:12 UTC.

maria.b: timeline note — customers reporting "rate limit exceeded" errors via support. Support ticket IDs: #20232, #20233.

support.jen: confirmed — 3 customers on paid Dedicated are reporting 429s on generate endpoints. Support sent temporary notice with ETA.

ryan.s: running quick query on quota-mapper metrics:```
# prometheus-ish
sum(rate(rate_limiter_denied_total[2m])) by (reason,region) 
reason="quota_misapply", region="eu-west-1" -> 120/s
reason="burst", region="us-west-2" -> 15/s
```

leo: also seeing errors in limiter logs (kv mismatch) — sample: ``[2026-03-14T09:14:05Z] ERROR limiter: tenant=acme-corp quota_lookup failed: route_tag missing -> fallback = DENY``

maria.b: interesting — route_tag missing suggests policy lookup failed. Could be a recent rollout. Any config change in last hour?

ryan.s: checking infra-deploys — I see a canary of quota-mapper v2 rolled at 09:00 UTC to 10% of traffic: deploy/quota-mapper-v2-20260314-canary

leo: oh — the canary introduced a defaulting bug: if `route_tag` absent, it returns null instead of fallback to global_quota. That would cause misapplied denies.

maria.b: mitigation plan: 1) shift traffic away from quota-mapper-v2 canary 2) enable fallback feature flag to force global_quota 3) notify customers. Which can we do fastest?

ryan.s: we can scale down the canary by patching the rollout weight via the orchestrator. Command: `orbctl rollout set quota-mapper-v2 --weight 0`

leo: agree — setting weight 0 now.

leo: `orbctl` output: replacing rollout, new weights applied. verified: canary weight -> 0%.

maria.b: after scaling down, what do metrics show?

ryan.s: requerying:```
sum(rate(rate_limiter_denied_total[1m])) by (reason,region)
reason="quota_misapply", region="eu-west-1" -> 8/s (was 120/s)
```

support.jen: customer #20232 reports fewer 429s; they see degraded throughput but errors decreasing.

maria.b: good. we should also back out the code change or patch the null handling. Who owns quota-mapper? @leo?

leo: yes, I'll open an emergency rollback PR for quota-mapper-v2 and cherry-pick a guard: if `route_tag == null` -> fallback to global quota. PR number: 4821 (emergency).

leo: PR merged to canary branch, but since weight is 0 it's not live. will schedule full rollback if we see relapse.

pagerduty: Incident PDR-94621 acknowledged by maria.b.

maria.b: customer impact assessment: affected users experiencing 429s for generation endpoints, primarily Dedicated customers in eu-west-1; estimated impacted customer count: 3 confirmed, possible transient impact to additional tenants due to routing. Severity: P2 (customer-facing but partial).

ryan.s: adding temporary rule to allow permissive fallback in limiter config:```
# limiter-config patch
- name: enforce-strict-route
  enabled: true
+ name: permissive-fallback
  enabled: true
  params:
    fallback: global_quota
```

leo: applying patch to config-store -> config-reload triggered.

incident-bot: config-change detected by deploy-bot: limiter-config patched -> reload succeeded.

maria.b: post-mitigation checks: 429 rate back to baseline?

ryan.s: querying: `rate(rate_limiter_denied_total[1m])` -> 1-2/s mostly transient. logs show route_tag errors gone.

support.jen: customers #20232/20233 confirm errors resolved. #20234 (non-critical) still seeing occasional 429s but much improved.

maria.b: great. action items: leo to follow up with rollback/patch for quota-mapper-v2; ryans to run a postmortem checklist and capture metrics; support to notify impacted customers with timeline and RCA when ready.

leo: started follow-up ticket INFRA-9302: "quota-mapper-v2: null route_tag guard and rollout playbook". ETA for fix: 3 hours.

ryan.s: I'll run through the rollback playbook and add smoke tests to protect route_tag logic. Also adding alert to detect sudden spike in `quota_misapply` reason specifically.

maria.b: will keep incident open for monitoring for 30m. If stable, will close and file P2 postmortem.

incident-bot: Monitor window started by maria.b for 30 minutes.

ryan.s: quick note — adding temporary dashboard: `ops/ratecap/quickview` with `quota_misapply` and 429p99 latency. Link: https://grafana.internal/ratecap/quickview (private).

leo: thumbs on the infra ticket, will coordinate with release to avoid rolling v2 until patch validated.

support.jen: sent proactive update to impacted customers with interim workaround.

maria.b: closing update in 20 minutes if metrics stable. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident PDR-94621 mitigated (routing/rollback path applied). Incident stays open for 20m monitoring.

ryan.s: one final ask — please add any logs or customer quotes to the ticket INFRA-9302 so we have runbook context.

maria.b: will do. if anything flares up @sre-oncall please alert.

sre-oncall: noted, will watch.

maria.b: final note for postmortem: root cause = canary defaulting bug in quota-mapper-v2 that returned null for missing route_tag, causing quota-mapper to deny instead of falling back. mitigation = scaled down canary + permissive fallback flag + config patch. Next steps = rollback/patch and stronger canary smoke tests.

pagerduty: PDR-94621 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

maria.b: last check: 429s remediated across regions. closing thread in 20. thanks everyone. :sparkles:
